'''''Droid Caller''''' was the personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]] of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] researcher [[Osaji Uhares]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] shared its name with [[Droid caller/Legends|droid callers]],<ref name="Threat" /> a device used to control droids.<ref name="DB">{{DB|technology|restrainingbolt|restraining bolt}}</ref> While working for his [[Osaji family|family's]] [[Osaji Syndicate|syndicate]] sometime between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and around two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040122threat|text=Triplet Threat|int=Triplet Threat}} is set in the [[Rebellion era]] and features [[Merl]], [[Uri]], and [[Glocken]], who all [[Death/Legends|perish]] in [[Star Wars (1977) 29|''Star Wars'' (1977) 29]]. {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}} dates the beginning of the Rebellion era to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], while ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' establishes that the events of the [[Star Wars (1977) 35|thirty-fifth issue]] of the [[1977]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] ongoing [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series took place by around two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], or [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Osaji kept ''Droid Caller'' with him on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Centares/Legends|Centares]].<ref name="Threat" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Droid Caller'' was introduced in "[[Triplet Threat]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] mini-adventure written by [[Jason Fry]] for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[January 22]], [[2004]].<ref name="Threat" />
